name: – § 6 – Am 1/3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text: 6a. Calls on the Commission to produce an independent study by the end of 2026 identifying the list of substances present in urban wastewater, verifying the costs of quaternary treatment, providing an attribution between relevant sectors under the ‘polluter pays’ principle and identifying the potential impact on the availability, affordability and accessibility of medicines, in particular generic and critical medicines and their active substances, and to, if necessary on the basis of the study results, accelerate the evaluation of the allocation of substances; considers that the Member States should be appropriately involved in the study, within their areas of competence, through the Pharmaceutical Committee, the European Environmental Agency and the European Medicines Agency;
